verdict.rationale: Dots is a hosted agent product. Asking whether its UI functionality is also exposed through an API is a fair question for this kind of product, so the axis applies. The evidence shows access only through ChatGPT, Slack, Teams, calls and mobile. The OpenAPI probes all returned 404, and runtime probing found no dots-specific public API, CLI, or MCP surface. The docs being available as markdown and through llms.txt makes the documentation machine-readable, but it is not an API for operating the product.
